title: Listen and Choose a Response — Shopping

questions.stem: Doesn't that shoe store close at six?

options.A: These shoes are a bit too close-fitting.
options.B: The store is on the second floor.
options.C: Let's hurry, then; we still have twenty minutes.

questions.explanation: Reacting with urgency implies the store does close soon; the 'No' option contradicts itself.
